entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: The God of Passage on Theros, a veiled ferryman who guides mortal souls across the river to the Underworld.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Athreos is a god.

entities.name: Katabasis
entities.description: Athreos's ancient staff, which becomes a skiff when laid across a river.

entities.name: Tartyx River
entities.description: One of the five Rivers That Ring the World, across which Athreos ferries the dead.

entities.name: Rivers That Ring the World
entities.description: Five rivers encircling Theros; the dead are ferried across them.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The realm of the dead on Theros.

entities.name: Kunoros
entities.description: Athreos's three-headed hound who guards the borders of the Underworld.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who sensed Daxos's power and sent Athreos to take him.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god in tension with Athreos over the dead.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea who holds a cold respect for Athreos.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: A god who tried to intervene when Athreos took Daxos.

entities.name: Lidia
entities.description: A mother who offered herself in place of her son Daxos and was taken to the Underworld.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Lidia's son, whose oracular power Erebos sought to claim.

entities.name: Kroxa
entities.description: An imprisoned titan in the Underworld whose chains Athreos shatters to destroy the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who attacked the Underworld during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: A time when the gods of Theros became inactive, leaving souls unferried.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion during which the Underworld came under attack.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Souls trapped between life and death outside the Underworld's entrances.

events.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to take Daxos to the Underworld; despite Karametra's efforts Athreos seizes the boy, and Lidia offers herself in his place and is taken instead.
events.quote: Lidia offered herself in her son's place and was taken to the Underworld instead.

events.summary: During the Silence of the Gods, Athreos becomes inactive, souls cannot be ferried, and Returned accumulate outside the Underworld.
events.quote: Athreos, like the other deities of Theros, became inactive.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion, Athreos shatters Kroxa's chains so it can destroy the Phyrexians in the Underworld.
events.quote: Athreos shattered the chains that bound the titan, allowing it to lay waste to the Phyrexian forces.

events.summary: Athreos sends Kunoros to accompany and restrain Kroxa so it cannot escape the Underworld.
events.quote: Athreos sent his hound, Kunoros , to accompany and restrain the titan during its rampage.

relations.note: His primary servant, a three-headed hound.
relations.quote: Athreos's primary servant is his three-headed hound, Kunoros

relations.note: Tension over interference with life and death.
relations.quote: This has led to tensions with Heliod and Erebos

relations.note: Carries out Erebos's command to take Daxos.
relations.quote: Erebos sent Athreos to take Daxos to the Underworld.

relations.note: She holds a cold respect for him.
relations.quote: Thassa , god of the sea, holds a cold respect for Athreos
When Lidia visited Athreos's shrine in the Despair Lands with her son Daxos
